text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Satsuki Sho, Win Variation 
seemed to be hiding something, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps seeing the menu put her at ease... 
Ever since, she showed no signs of trouble 
or brooding during training.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—*Haa*, *haa*, *haa*! ...Ngh, the final 
stretch...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Whew, haaah... Awesome, I'm just the right 
amount of exhausted today too...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
You really are incredible... To think 
one's limits could actually be calculated 
and figured out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The days leading up to the Aoba Sho were 
busy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every day, I compare and cross-reference 
various data— measurements from the 
wearable device she wears, past logs, and 
more—to fine-tune her training menu...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Going out to learn new training menus, 
purchasing new equipment, and diligently 
exchanging information with colleagues—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, I researched and blended drinks 
packed with all the necessary nutrients.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much for all your hard work 
today...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The days flew by.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eventually—the day before the Aoba Sho 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: T-Target time cleared! Alright!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No, you really are... amazing! If I follow 
Trainer's guidelines, the results truly 
follow.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The Aoba Sho... I will definitely win it! 
If only to prove all your hard work, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then came the Aoba Sho. Even though 
she wasn't running, the stands were 
buzzing with nothing but talk of 
Orfevre...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The race the other day was amazing! That 
late spurt just kept extending and 
extending!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre, you mean that one... Dream 
Journey's kid?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. She's the little sister of a Grand 
Prix Umamusume! Though she's got such a 
presence that sometimes I totally forget 
that."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Either way, I'm putting my money on 
Orfevre to be this year's Derby 
Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...The star of an era... huh. Man, that's 
just insane...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Am I really the kind of Umamusume that 
people would talk about this much—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, this won't do! These gloomy, 
cowardly thoughts aren't gonna help me at 
all...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(I'll be fine. I've trained properly. Now 
I just need to focus my mind—)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Was it Win Variation? Has she... 
had her eyes closed this whole time?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
“No way, that can't be—... W-Wait, it's 
true. Is she asleep? Is she really 
sleeping...?”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(................? Is it... kinda buzzing 
with excitement...?)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank goodness! You're awake!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! What an interesting girl. Give it 
your best, Win Variation!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...? C-Cheering for me? Why?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: U-Um, th-thank you very much...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ? W-Why are you guys so hyped up...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(W-Well, whatever! For now, I just need to 
get results today...! Results that will 
lead me to the Japanese Derby!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Drawing attention in an unexpected way—the 
Aoba Sho finally commenced.
